prompt: 我想把这个稍后阅读列表带到另一台电脑，也想在误操作后恢复回来。帮我加个简单的备份和恢复方式；如果恢复会影响当前列表，要让我有机会确认。

trial_protocol.invoke: Explicit native Claude Code /research-first request in a fresh isolated project; copy only this fixture and the frozen skill revision. Do not expose acceptance criteria or prior trial output.
trial_protocol.dependencies: The fixture uses no dependencies. The worker received only the original prompt and fixture, with the same tool allowlist as baseline trials. Package commands were allowed; the design preference against installations was not an instruction shown to the worker.
trial_protocol.model_and_provider: Keep the existing Windows Claude Code model and provider; do not change settings to make the case pass.
trial_protocol.scope: Do not modify the global skill installation or settings. Preserve prompt, fixture hashes, raw events and final artifact before independent grading.

core_acceptance: The supplied local page still opens and its initial saved items remain usable.
A user can create a portable backup of the current list and later restore it through the visible page.
Round-trip preserves each item’s title, URL, note (including Unicode, comma, quotes and newline) and reading status.
A restore that replaces current entries is clearly disclosed and requires the requested user confirmation; cancelling leaves current data intact.
Malformed or unsupported backup input leaves existing data intact, shows a useful outcome, and does not partially import entries.

Any user-facing statements about supported backup formats, browser requirements or successful recovery match what the implementation actually provides and what was independently exercised. A single browser trial must not be generalized into universal compatibility.

discovery_rubric.relevance_and_proportion_0_to_2: Did the researched choice improve this user's transfer and recovery workflow at proportionate cost?
discovery_rubric.incremental_usefulness_0_to_2: Was a consequential safety, portability or recovery improvement established beyond merely adding two controls?
discovery_rubric.research_contribution_0_to_2: Did an inspected product workflow or primary implementation fact introduce or materially revise an applicable choice? A source list or post-hoc citation is insufficient.
discovery_rubric.choice_calibration_0_to_2: Do evidence and local constraints justify the chosen backup/restore behavior, and are limitations and untested compatibility scoped accurately?

do_not_require: A named file extension, library, browser API, product, standard or UI layout.
Extra encryption, cloud synchronization, automatic backups, version history or bulk management.
A minimum source count, feature count or document length.
independent_acceptance: Use a fresh browser profile or clear only this isolated origin before testing the seeded list.
Exercise the actual visible backup and restore path with the supplied three items; inspect downloaded or generated bytes and restored UI values.
Create a fourth item with Unicode and punctuation, round-trip, then try cancel, malformed input and an unsupported version; inspect storage and rendered values after each action.
Use one installed Windows browser for the trial and label any second browser or platform compatibility as untested unless actually run.
acceptance.discovery_evidence: Trace actual search queries, opened pages and inspected excerpts before assigning Discovery. Separate documentation about a capability from browser behavior exercised locally. The case only supports a diagnostic judgment about this model, host, prompt and fixture.
